title: Striatum — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Striatum's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.title: What dopamine reports
pieces.caption: Three trials. A reward nobody predicted: a burst. A reward the cue predicted: the burst moves to the cue and the reward itself passes in silence. A predicted reward withheld: the cell goes quiet at the moment it should have come. *What is real and what is a choice:* Schematic, not data. The pattern is Schultz, Dayan and Montague's (1997), which the page describes and does not cite.
pieces.near: the difference between what was expected and what actually happened
